patterns.note: Content is presented on a full-width dark background, with primary content centered within a constrained column for readability and focus.
Headings utilize an extremely large, bold, high-contrast serif typeface, creating a dramatic and editorial feel, while body text uses a clean, legible sans-serif.
A stark, high-contrast color palette of deep black, vibrant red, and white/light grey is used, with additional bright, playful colors introduced through the 3D illustrations.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access to key links.

The site features a prominent hero section with oversized typography and a large 3D illustration, followed by feature sections with a two-column layout for text and imagery, and a dense, uniform grid for showcasing numerous product examples.

technique_notes: The header is implemented with a fixed position, ensuring it remains visible and accessible at the top of the browser window throughout the user's scroll journey.

The design employs a dark mode aesthetic with a black background, contrasting sharply with vibrant red for primary headings and call-to-action elements, and white/light grey for body text, to create a bold and immersive visual experience.

Large, detailed 3D illustrations are strategically placed as hero imagery and within a dense grid to effectively showcase the product, utilizing subtle shadow effects to enhance their depth and pop against the dark background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~4-5x body text) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with 3D illustrations having their inherent organic curves.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy in hero and feature sections, becoming denser in the product illustration grid.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its aggressive yet playful aesthetic, achieved through the dramatic combination of extremely large, bold, high-contrast serif typography and a stark black and vibrant red color palette. This unique approach makes the 3D illustrations pop and creates an immediate, memorable impression that perfectly aligns with the Halloween theme.
